title: James Armistead's intelligence at Yorktown
summary: Enslaved man James Armistead posed as a British courier and passed intelligence that helped American and French forces force Cornwallis to surrender.
why: Helped decide the last major battle of the American Revolution.

unsung.contribution: Spied on British forces, providing intelligence instrumental in the Yorktown surrender.
unsung.recognition: As a spy who carried no gun, he was excluded from Virginia's law freeing slave soldiers; freed only in 1787.
